edits.after:
static DEFINE_PER_CPU(int, mmap_lock_recursion);

#define TRACE_MMAP_LOCK_EVENT(type, mm, ...)                                   \
	do {                                                                   \
		const char *memcg_path;                                        \
		preempt_disable();                                             \
		if (unlikely(__this_cpu_read(mmap_lock_recursion))) {          \
			preempt_enable();                                      \
			break;                                                 \
		}                                                              \
		__this_cpu_inc(mmap_lock_recursion);                           \
		preempt_enable();                                              \
		local_lock(&memcg_paths.lock);                                 \
		memcg_path = get_mm_memcg_path(mm);                            \
		trace_mmap_lock_##type(mm,                                     \
				       memcg_path != NULL ? memcg_path : "",   \
				       ##__VA_ARGS__);                         \
		if (likely(memcg_path != NULL))                                \
			put_memcg_path_buf();                                  \
		local_unlock(&memcg_paths.lock);                               \
		preempt_disable();                                             \
		__this_cpu_dec(mmap_lock_recursion);                           \
		preempt_enable();                                              \
	} while (0)
